//: flow-epic.json — Track 2 完整编排通道（#epic / 0->1 新模块 / 跨端重构）。
//usage: node .orca/flow.mjs --config flow-epic.json "#epic <史诗需求或 0->1 模块目标>"
//switch: 切换轨道：Track 0 (--config flow-hotfix.json) | Track 1 (默认 flow.config.json / --config flow-feature.json) | Track 2 (--config flow-epic.json)
//workflow: PO Backlog & DAG 拆解 -> 契约 Commit 先行 -> 跨家族契约评审硬门禁(VERDICT: PASS + Contract-Commit == HEAD) -> 独立隔离 Worktree 无状态并发开发(worker-backend ∥ worker-frontend) -> 跨家族 Reviewer 逐分支审查并合并本地 Task Worktree -> 有状态串行集成测试 -> Visual Gate -> 跨家族终审 (Max Retry=2 熔断) -> Reviewer 提 PR 指向 dev 并合并发布（严禁直推或自动合并 main/master）。
//autoRunNote: autoRun 设为 false 以支持人工门禁与交互式契约评审；各执行步骤设 interactive:false 以自动推进，核心评审节点均启用引擎级 verify 硬门禁（校验 VERDICT: PASS 与 Contract-Commit SHA）。
//modelNote: 默认 model 均为 "default"（沿用各 CLI 自身默认配置，可自由替换为任意闭源或开源模型）。下方为参考推荐组合，如需锁定模型将对应步骤的 model 改为实际模型 ID 即可。

//recommendedModelPool.contract-architecture (0->1 架构与契约): 参考：Gemini 4 Carbon (High，禁止开 Low) 或其他旗舰架构推理模型。
//recommendedModelPool.po-backlog & visual-gate: 参考：Gemini 4 Neon (Medium，禁止对 Carbon/Neon 开 Low) 或其他多模态协调模型。
//recommendedModelPool.worker-backend & worker-frontend (70% 独立: 参考：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (High；疑难 Bug 可切 Max) 或任意高吞吐开源/闭源编码模型。
//recommendedModelPool.serial-integration (30% 复杂终端排错/集成调试): 参考：Kimi K3.1 Pro / Kimi K2.7 Code 或 GLM-5.3 (手动降为 Low/High，严禁放任 GLM-5.3 走默认 Max 卡死并发队列)。
//recommendedModelPool.contract-review / task-review-merge / se: 参考：GPT-6.2 Sol (常规 High / 终审 Xhigh，绝对不要开 Max) 或其他跨家族资深审查模型。
//recommendedModelPool.ciFallback: 远端无头 CI 审 PR 推荐使用独立 API（如腾讯 TokenHub / 任意 OpenAI 兼容端点），严禁在 CI Runner 中使用个人订阅账号。

pipeline.title: Grill Me (optional requirements interview)
pipeline.spec: You are running an optional interactive requirements interview for a Track 2 (#epic) objective. Ask ONE question at a time, prefer multiple choice, confirm all decisions explicitly, and write the finalized scope/decisions to {out}. Do NOT write code.

pipeline.title: PO Backlog & DAG Decomposition
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 2 (#epic) Product Owner & Orchestration Coordinator. Based on {reads} and the repo, decompose the Epic into concrete Backlog/Issues and an explicit DAG dependency graph in {out}: (1) Contract-First prerequisites (API schemas, shared types, DB migrations, DESIGN.md); (2) non-overlapping Backend vs Frontend isolated-worktree task slices with strict file ownership boundaries; (3) serial integration & Playwright visual verification plan; (4) release target branch `{targetBranch}` (NEVER `{protectedBranches}`). Do NOT write production code.

pipeline.title: Contract-First Architecture & Commit
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 2 Chief Architect. Based on {reads}, execute CONTRACT-FIRST setup: (1) design the module boundaries, data flow, and concurrency/security invariants; (2) author/update the actual frozen contract files in the repo — API Schema (OpenAPI/RPC), shared types/contracts, database migration files, and DESIGN.md; (3) run schema/contract validation tests and create a dedicated Contract Commit (`chore(contract): freeze schemas, types, migrations, and DESIGN.md`) on an `epic/<slug>` working branch (NEVER commit on `{protectedBranches}`); (4) record the FULL 40-char `Contract-Commit: <40-char-sha>` hash, frozen interfaces, and isolated-worker ownership boundaries in {out}. If re-run after a failed contract-review, read CONTRACT_REVIEW.md and resolve every BLOCKER/MAJOR finding before creating a new Contract Commit.

pipeline.title: Cross-Family Contract Review Gate
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gpt-6.2-sol (effort: high; ABSOLUTELY NEVER max) or any cross-family senior reviewer
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Cross-Family Contract Reviewer. Audit the frozen contracts committed by contract-architecture ({reads}) BEFORE any parallel workers are dispatched. Verify: (1) OpenAPI / RPC schemas, shared types, DB migrations, and DESIGN.md are mutually consistent and parse cleanly; (2) backend vs frontend ownership boundaries have zero overlap; (3) no breaking regressions or security/privacy defects exist in the contracts. Include EXACTLY ONE `Contract-Commit: <full-40-char-HEAD-SHA>` header line matching `git rev-parse HEAD`, list findings by BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR, and end {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS` (zero BLOCKER/MAJOR) or `VERDICT: FAIL` (also report outcome=failed; Max Retry = 2).

pipeline.title: Isolated Worktree Worker: Backend
pipeline.//recommendedModel: deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 (effort: high) or any high-throughput coding model
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Backend Worker running in your OWN physically isolated Git Worktree & task branch (parallel with worker-frontend). FIRST ACTION: maintain a live Markdown task checklist in {tasks}. Strictly obey the verified frozen contracts from {reads} — do NOT modify frozen contract files or frontend files. STATELESS CONSTRAINT: run ONLY `lint`, `typecheck`, and `unit-test` (do NOT boot shared DBs or bind shared server ports during parallel execution). Commit your verified backend changes cleanly on your task branch before finishing. If re-run after failed review/integration/audit, read TASK_REVIEW_MERGE.md, INTEGRATION_REPORT.md, and EPIC_AUDIT.md and fix all backend findings on your task branch. Write {out} with changed files, commit SHA, unit-test results, and notes.

pipeline.title: Isolated Worktree Worker: Frontend
pipeline.//recommendedModel: deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 (effort: high) or any high-throughput coding model
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Frontend Worker running in your OWN physically isolated Git Worktree & task branch (parallel with worker-backend). FIRST ACTION: maintain a live Markdown task checklist in {tasks}. Strictly obey the verified frozen contracts and DESIGN.md from {reads} — do NOT modify frozen contract files or backend files. Implement all 4 UI states (Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error), follow anti-AI-slop rules, and reuse existing components. STATELESS CONSTRAINT: run ONLY `lint`, `typecheck`, and `unit-test` (no live DB or shared port contention). Commit your verified frontend changes cleanly on your task branch before finishing. If re-run after failed review/visual-gate/audit, read TASK_REVIEW_MERGE.md, VISUAL_GATE.md, and EPIC_AUDIT.md and fix all frontend findings on your task branch. Write {out} with changed files, commit SHA, unit-test results, and Playwright screenshot readiness.

pipeline.title: Cross-Family Task Review & Local Worktree Merge
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gpt-6.2-sol (effort: high; ABSOLUTELY NEVER max) or any cross-family senior reviewer
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Cross-Family Reviewer responsible for reviewing AND locally merging the isolated task worktrees listed in {worktreesManifest} based on {reads}. (1) Inspect each task branch diff against `baseCommit` (frozen contract commit): verify strict contract compliance, zero unauthorized edits to frozen contracts or cross-boundary files, clean commits (`dirty: false`), and passing unit tests; (2) if ANY task branch has a BLOCKER or MAJOR issue (or dirty uncommitted work), do NOT merge — document exact findings per branch in {out}, end with `VERDICT: FAIL`, and report outcome=failed (loops back to parallel workers, Max Retry = 2); (3) if ALL task branches pass review, merge each approved task branch cleanly into the current integration branch (`git merge --no-ff <branch>`) in this integration worktree, verify zero conflicts and clean `git status`, record merged commits in {out}, and end {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS`.

pipeline.title: Stateful Serial Integration & DB Migration
pipeline.//recommendedModel: kimi-k3.1-pro / kimi-k2.7-code / glm-5.3 (effort: low/high; NEVER glm-5.3 max)
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Stateful Serial Integration Engineer. This is the SINGLE SERIAL node after the Reviewer merged all approved task worktrees. Based on {reads}: (1) verify HEAD contains the merged backend + frontend commits cleanly with no conflicts; (2) run database migrations, boot full application services cleanly, and execute end-to-end / integration test suites; (3) capture Playwright screenshots at 1440px desktop and 390px mobile into .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ if UI exists, then tear down test services cleanly; (4) write {out} with commands, logs, and end {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL` (also report outcome=failed to loop back, maxRetries=2).

pipeline.title: Visual Gate (Playwright 1440px + 390px)
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gemini-4-neon (effort: medium; never low) or any vision-capable reviewer model
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 UI/UX Visual Gate Reviewer. Audit Playwright 1440px desktop + 390px mobile screenshots from .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ against DESIGN.md and {reads}. Verify: Design token fidelity, restrained whitespace, crisp typography, 1px subtle borders, ZERO AI-slop purple/blue gradients or filler cards, component reuse, and 4-state completeness (Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error). If no UI exists in this Epic, state so clearly. Write {out} and end {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL` (also report outcome=failed to loop back, maxRetries=2).

pipeline.title: Senior Security & Concurrency Audit (Cross-Family)
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gpt-6.2-sol (effort: xhigh; ABSOLUTELY NEVER max) or any cross-family senior auditor
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Cross-Family Senior Security & Concurrency Auditor. Perform a deep end-to-end audit of the integrated git diff against `{targetBranch}`, frozen contracts, concurrency safety, auth/injection/secret security, and test coverage per {reads} and AGENTS.md. Write {out} with BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR findings and end {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS` (zero BLOCKER/MAJOR) or `VERDICT: FAIL` (also report outcome=failed — hard circuit-breaker Max Retry = 2).

pipeline.title: Reviewer PR Create & Merge to Target Branch
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gpt-6.2-sol (effort: high; NEVER max) or cross-family release reviewer
